item.title: How Long After Eating Do IBS Symptoms Start? A Timing Guide to Bloating, Gas and Cramps
item.description: How long after eating do IBS symptoms start? Minutes for the gut reflex, a few hours for dairy, 4+ hours for FODMAPs. See the timing table and why it matters.
